text: I have received a petition from area residents requesting the installation of speed humps on Langford Avenue between Danforth and Aldwych Avenues. This request is to address concerns regarding vehicle speeds and road safety.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District, to investigate the feasibility of traffic calming measures on Langford Avenue, between Aldwych Avenue and Danforth Avenue, in the form of speed humps.
